notes.title: Oku at PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're very excited to announce that OKU will feature in [b]PC Gamer's Tokyo Direct Showcase[/b] this sunday![/p][p]Tune in and look forward to a sparkling new trailer from us, we're excited to share more of the game with you <3[/p][p][/p][p]🗓️ When: September 28th, 9 AM PT / 6PM CEST[/p][p]Where: Twitch, YouTube and Steam[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/pcgamer"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/user/pcgamer"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Hope to see you there! [/p]

notes.content: [p]Come and join the Best Indie Games celebration of all the wonderful upcoming Indie Games on Youtube and Steam! We are very grateful to be among so many heartwarming projects by independent teams.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@ClemmyGames"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: OKU just gathered 100.000 wishlists!
notes.content: [p]A few months ago no one here would have ever dreamed of the game doing so well. We are glad that all the hard work and research we put into making something authentic and unique seems to pay off! May our young monk keep traveling far to spread the joy of poetry.[/p][p][/p][p]We are currently preparing for Gamescom and have a bunch of exciting plans for our booth! Hopefully we will see some of you there. [/p][h2]Thank you for the amazing support![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651718/d55a4eb631dae539cce46a89229585c93a982f77.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: OKU joins Tiny Teams
notes.content: [p]Come and join us to celebrate all those wonderful games from developers with few helping hands, but a big heart! Go watch the livestreams, tell your friends and don't forget to wishlist some of those great games![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][i]The monk is honored.[/i][/h3][h3][i]Celebrate the tiny teams.[/i][/h3][h3]Let them all succeed.[/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651718/0722849c934b9373456a88da85d61326b756d31b.png"][/img][/h3]

notes.title: OKU had a great announcement!
notes.content: [p]We are super excited to see that so many of you seem to be interested in our Japan-inspired poetry exploration game  It is already trending on Steam and is amongst the most followed upcoming games. We are very grateful for all your support and will work hard to make the game as good as possible! It will still take some time, but we can't wait to put you in the sandals of our travelling monk.[/p][p][/p][p]Have a wonderful week![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651718/353539110a1f09bb277bb8f5527b45829cb3cf1d.png"][/img][/p]
